verdict.rationale: Twenty documents workflows triggered by record changes, schedules, manual actions, or incoming webhooks. Those workflows can chain record operations, send email, HTTP requests, code, branches, delays and AI agents, and the docs give Slack alerts on deal-stage changes as an example of automated notifications. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating Task records as a workflow step (only implied via generic record operations), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the workflow engine works reliably in practice.
